lead.title: Madrid's Wilco raises €2.5M led by Samaipata for AI agents that walk patients all the way to the clinic chair
lead.deck: Wilco deploys AI agents (voice and messaging) that follow every patient request through to the consultation and treatment-plan acceptance, handing over to staff or a clinician as soon as a clinical question comes up; its customers are large dental, ophthalmology, aesthetics and veterinary clinic groups such as Vitaldent, Baviera and WM Clinics. The round, led by Samaipata with ABAC Nest Ventures and industry executives, will fund engineering, deployment and expansion into the rest of Europe, the US and Latin America: a bet on the 60-80% of requests lost before the first appointment, measured in visits and accepted treatments rather than calls handled.

milestone.title: In Wales, Aneurin Bevan cuts mental health referral processing from 30 days to half a day with RPA
milestone.summary: The Welsh health board handed referral processing for its primary care mental health support service to software robots (RPA): turnaround fell from up to 30 days to about 0.5 day, with 95% compliance against the 28-day target. More than 72,000 patients have been onboarded to digital outcome collection, yielding over 147,000 PROMs and 1,700 PREMs, ahead of a switch of its patient record to Rio planned for March 2027.
milestone.why: The simplest kind of administrative automation delivers a measurable gain in access to care here, with no generative AI or new device: proof that workflow and outcomes vendors can sell to the NHS on immediate operational ROI, at a time when AI budgets are struggling to scale.

deal.thesis: Founded by Chiara Longhi (CEO) and neonatologist Valentina Bozzetti (CMO), the Rome startup brings a child's health record (discharge letters, test results, vaccinations, paediatric visits) into one app, with an AI assistant that answers parents using paediatric guidelines curated by its clinical team. The round, co-led by Techshop Capital and Exceptional Ventures with Vento and Moffu Labs, bets on the parent as the entry point to the patient record: a paediatric segment still underserved by consumer health platforms.

brefsEurope.title: Teleconsultation platform Qare confirms theft of patient account data and has notified the CNIL
brefsEurope.summary: In an intrusion on October 31, resolved the same day according to the company, an attacker accessed patients' civil status, contact details, sex and date of birth; Qare says no health data was affected. A complaint has been filed, patients informed and the CNIL notified. A reminder for telehealth players: cybersecurity is becoming as decisive a buying criterion as patient experience.

brefsEurope.title: Conecsio wins the Grand Prix of the 2026 Trophées de la e-santé for speeding up clinical trial recruitment
brefsEurope.summary: The AI and health-data platform, which helps identify investigator sites and eligible patients, took the jury's Grand Prix at the 20th Université de la e-santé in Castres; MAGE-X, which turns unstructured patient records into validated clinical databases, won the Health Data prize. Two building blocks upstream of the EHDS, where reusing data for research is becoming a market.

brefsEurope.company: Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
brefsEurope.title: Chelsea and Westminster rolls out multilingual AI avatars of its team to guide patients with suspected lung cancer
brefsEurope.summary: Designed by the hospital's clinicians under respiratory consultant Orhan Orhan, with patient advocates, the platform explains tests and appointments through avatar videos of the team in the ten most-requested languages, plus written content and an AI-assisted Q&A module. It is being deployed across the suspected cancer pathway and could be extended to other services.

brefsEurope.title: Ireland co-leads a WHO Europe digital mental health roadmap running to 2035
brefsEurope.summary: Built with the HSE, the roadmap covers six domains (strategy, governance, standards and regulation, infrastructure, skills, evaluation) in three phases, from data protection standards to procurement rules and full integration into the care system. WHO rates the evidence for internet-delivered CBT in depression and anxiety as solid: a common framework that will ease public procurement for digital mental health vendors.

brefsEurope.title: Swansea Bay outsources its digital pathology services to Business and Service Solutions for £400k
brefsEurope.summary: The Welsh health board is outsourcing its digital pathology services for four months, from November 2026 to March 2027, to the Stockport company, awarded through a framework agreement without competition. A sign that remote slide reading is already serving as a release valve for stretched laboratories.

brefsEurope.company: East and North Hertfordshire Teaching NHS Trust
brefsEurope.title: East and North Hertfordshire receives 1,000 Copilot licences from NHS England and pilots ambient AI in ENT
brefsEurope.summary: The trust has 1,000 Copilot licences funded until March 2027 (normally £80,000 a year), whose renewal will depend on a benefits evaluation, and is testing ambient voice technology in ENT and pre-operative assessment before any wider rollout, subject to a future procurement. Its 2026-2030 quality strategy plans to embed AI in quality management by 2028-2030.

brefsIntl.title: Artera launches AI patient-intake agents to tackle claim denials caused by registration errors
brefsIntl.summary: Built on its Harmony platform, Artera Intake uses AI agents (SMS/RCS, web, voice) to collect information before the visit, at check-in and for complex consents, with a staff dashboard; the vendor serves more than 1,000 provider organisations and cites 56% of providers blaming denied claims on patient data errors. The same digital front door market Wilco is targeting in Europe.

brefsIntl.title: Only 2% of large healthcare organisations have scaled AI with measurable benefits, KPMG finds
brefsIntl.summary: The Global Healthcare CEO Outlook 2026 (100 leaders of organisations with over $500M in revenue) shows 52% deploying AI across several areas and 41% still experimenting, while 83% call it an investment priority for the next three years and 23% expect a return within 6 to 12 months. The gap between pilots and scale remains the window for solutions with proven ROI.

word.full: Digital Front Door (the digital entry point to the care pathway)
word.field: Access to care and patient engagement
word.definition: All the digital channels through which a patient first contacts a hospital or practice (website, portal, booking, online triage, messaging, teleconsultation), designed to steer them to the right care without going through the phone line or front desk.

parts.label: Triage
parts.role: routing (symptoms, urgency, right level of care)

parts.label: Follow-up
parts.role: reminders and nudges through to the consultation and treatment

how.t: The patient describes their need on the web, in the app or by phone, where a questionnaire or an AI agent collects their information.
A clinical triage engine assesses urgency and directs them to the right pathway: self-care, teleconsultation, an in-person appointment or the emergency department.
Automated booking, reminders and follow-ups until the patient shows up, with handover to a human as soon as a clinical question arises.

word.why: Patients want this self-service: 72% cite quicker access to a doctor and 58% appointment scheduling as improvements since the pandemic, according to Experian Health. For a VC, it is where agentic AI monetises fastest, in admin hours saved and appointments no longer lost, as shown by GP Triage's certified triage in the NHS and Wilco's raise with clinic groups.
